name: figthread
description: Design, validate, browser-review, multi-target package, browser-capture PNG/export, and resume semantic figure work from promoted evidence-bound authority.

interface.longDescription: A semantic figure authoring skill that turns claims into promoted semantic, grammar, visual, profile, deterministic linear or registered radial layout, and rendering authority, certifies browser-resolved text bounds and platform fonts, compiles semantic motion, packages independently promoted targets into self-contained HTML, captures PNG from exact promoted HTML through bundled Chrome/Chromium, exports content-addressed derivatives, and supports resumable evidence-bound execution.
defaultPrompt: Use Figthread for this explanatory figure.
Turn this claim into a deterministic radial lifecycle or hub-spoke figure.
Export the promoted figure as a browser-captured PNG.
Turn this claim into independently promoted desktop and compact target figures and package them together.
Resume and validate this figure from its Figthread run directory.
